verdict.rationale: Airweave's 'agentic search' is an AI agent embedded in the product that iteratively searches data via tool calling, reads documents, and navigates hierarchies — a limited form of task delegation to a built-in AI assistant, but scoped only to search/retrieval rather than general task delegation. Missing for 10: evidence of a general-purpose built-in assistant beyond search, ability to delegate broader actions (e.g. writing, configuring, multi-step workflows) to an in-product assistant, and independent hands-on confirmation of this delegation experience.
